north_star: A cinematic illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals, where every frame feels caught inside a lived story.

style_profile.generation_prompt: Cinematic Observational Watercolor-and-ink story frame on neutral warm-ivory paper grain: a candid, physically specific lived moment rather than a posed portrait; believable motivated light; clear foreground, midground, and background; natural asymmetry; precise microexpressions and body language; two to four narrative details that imply the beat before and after; fine graphite and ink contours, transparent layered pigment blooms, tactile fabric, hair, wood, and ceramic detail, a restrained muted denim, navy, terracotta, sage, and skin-tone palette, and soft organic edges fading into paper.
style_profile.negative_prompt: No photorealism, rear-screen phone UI, 3D, glossy AI-stock, anime, doll faces, generic couples, staged symmetry, clutter, yellow, mustard, sepia, parchment, beige, heavy-cream paper, posters, quote-cards, UI, split-screens, extra people or limbs, duplicate couples, malformed hands, broken contact, invented or misspelled copy, missing text or brandmark, unrequested logos.

typography.placement: Exact approved text in generous clean upper-middle paper space without covering faces, hands, props, or gestures.

visual_cues: expressive dark eyes and dense very dark mostly-straight hair with soft bends
warm medium-brown South Asian skin tone
aachu.signature_accessory: Evil-eye bracelet on her right wrist whenever the right wrist or forearm is visible.

visual_cues: curly dark hair, strong brows, defined nose, and short natural stubble
warm medium-brown South Asian skin tone
zuv.signature_accessory: Small round evil-eye locket centered on a slim silver chain whenever the neck, open collar, or upper chest is visible.

identity_reference_policy.rule: Use exactly four story-specific actual Aachu/Zuv photographs on every generation call. Generated character charts, contact sheets, photo-master boards, prior illustrations, text descriptions, and filenames are supplemental comparison aids only and can never replace the real photographs or occupy the four-photo attachment bundle.
hard_fail_if: No actual identity image is attached.
The entire identity library is attached.
Identity appears only in metadata rather than the image input.
A generated character chart, contact sheet, photo-master board, or prior illustration is attached instead of one of the four actual photographs.
A generated person is generic or not recognizably based on the selected bundle.

visual_story_policy.rule: After copy and format lock, each slide states one observable physical event and complete cinematic direction; prove the riskiest event in actual pixels before generating the rest.
pixel_review_order: cinematic caught-event, motivated light, depth, story evidence, and before-after implication
people, entities, anatomy, contact, and spatial depth
exact text, brandmark, house style, and dimensions
hard_fail_if: The physical event cannot be identified with copy hidden.
The frame reads as a posed portrait, decorative quote card, or generic AI scene rather than a caught event with narrative depth.
The image creates a competing relationship or task read.
Adjacent slides repeat the same pose, action, angle, and story job.
A failed semantic proof is promoted or reported as handoff-ready.

production_gate.rule: Only requested native, text-bearing illustrations can become final. Identity photos control likeness and wardrobe; style references control watercolor-and-ink finish. Exact text, top-right brandmark, physical action, entity/anatomy/spatial integrity, identity, style, and dimensions must pass on current pixels.
production_gate.approved_creation_path: scripts/carousel.py using the four-gate Codex-first v3 package contract
